scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现堕落帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the fallen empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你们物种的复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of your species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里不会单独显示该物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species is not shown here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你们种族的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of your species appears here.
